test_hydra_missing_config: test that hydra raises MissingConfigException when config_path or config_name points to a non-existent file or directory
test_hydra_app_without_config: test running a hydra app with no config file and verify it returns an empty config dictionary
test_hydra_config_override: test overriding config values via command-line overrides like dataset.path=/datasets/imagenet2 in a hydra app
test_hydra_sweep_multirun: test hydra multirun sweeps with choice overrides like optimizer=adam,nesterov and verify multiple job returns
test_hydra_cfg_output: test the --cfg flag to print job, hydra, or all config as YAML with optional --resolve and --package flags
